adaptations: The Base Nova web Button uses the local cn utility, an explicit React client boundary and a public variant export.
Native components are Anhedral-maintained React Native ports, isolated from DOM components and without React Native Reusables.
Native themes derive their colors from the generated shared semantic tokens; no separate native palette is installed.
Native Dialog restores focus to its actionable trigger on both iOS dismissal and Android close transitions.
Recovered Input and Label use the local cn utility; Input delegates keyboard focus styling to the existing shared global focus rule.

native.implementation: Anhedral-owned React Native semantic adaptations. Native APIs replace browser-only DOM and interaction APIs; device acceptance is tracked separately.
